event.description: Factor tied token/output matrix through rank 6
event.proposal: family: token representation; retained incumbent is 4288 parameters at 99.9100%, a +0.91 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0002, which established reversed operand token order with 5056 parameters and 99.98%; same-family failed result: none; prior attempts in this family: 1. The latest feed-forward probes ff19 and ff18 both collapsed near 10%, so this proposal changes mechanism family rather than repeating that width condition. Hypothesis: represent input tokens and tied output logits through a shared rank-6 factorization, reducing the 15-by-16 token matrix from 240 to 15*6 + 6*16 = 186 parameters while preserving a shared input/output representation. The resulting model has 4234 parameters. This is more informative than rank4 as a first test because rank6 is the nearest lower-rank bottleneck and preserves more token information. Keep the accepted reversed preprocessing, ff20, learned positions, and 30000-step training; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 4288 parameters.
